scope.covers: multiarch roots, the Debian multiarch libc.so linker script, EGL/GLES soname chains and the KMSDRM-capable SDL of the image
scope.not_covered: the physical acceptance already recorded for the published port is not replayed here

evidence.result_scope: host-side ABI, root isolation, linker-script recognition, soname chains and compiled-SDL-driver verification only

image_layout.read_method: debugfs read-only with byte offset; never mounted, never looped, never written

topology.isolation_rule: each multiarch root is judged by the runtime ELFs it exposes; a runtime ELF of the wrong ABI rejects the whole root

linker_scripts.rule: a GNU ld script is a build artifact, never a runtime library: it must be skipped without rejecting the root that holds it

renderer.soname_note: medido nesta imagem: EGL, GLES e GBM do ramo AArch64 NAO declaram DT_SONAME. Eles entram como provedores presentes e de ABI conferida, nunca como cadeia de soname provada -- contar os dois juntos diria mais do que a leitura prova

profile_cross_check.note: a rota ARMHF do dArkOS e MIXED-ABI: o NXExtract roda na ABI nativa do host (AArch64) enquanto splash e jogo seguem ARMHF. E o que o recibo fisico do Titan Souls registrou naquele aparelho, citado aqui e nao repetido
